name: IREM Co.,Ltd.
summary: IREM Co., Ltd., a South Korean enterprise, is primarily involved in the production and distribution of stainless steel piping. Its operations are organized into two distinct business units: Steel Pipe and Superdeck. The Steel Pipe division provides essential components to a variety of sectors, including semiconductor fabrication, display manufacturing, petroleum refining, shipbuilding, general construction, and industrial machinery. Meanwhile, the Superdeck segment focuses on delivering broad integral decking solutions. The company commenced its activities on March 25, 1974, and its main office is situated in Buan-gun, South Korea.
